title: ScoreMyDataCenter watchlist file
description: A watchlist file is an ARRAY of 'En veille' entries (A-19): world projects tracked as sourced FACTS, never graded. No letter, no score, no confidence anywhere — additionalProperties:false makes a grade structurally impossible. Publishable without the contradictory review (facts, not a notation).

source.description: Entry-level source that justifies listing the project (press release, article). A tracked project always has one, even with an empty facts[].

facts.description: Sourced contestation facts (opposition, press, petition, moratorium…). MAY be empty: a tracked flagship with no contestation yet is justified by the entry-level source, no fake fact is fabricated.

provenance.description: Where the record came from and whether it may be published (veille chantier, 2026-07-30). A candidate seeded from a commercial source (DCMag) stays publishable:false until re-verified against an open source. Absent = publishable by default. Never a grade.

license.description: REAL licence id (ODbL-1.0 | Licence Ouverte 2.0 | CC-BY-4.0 | commercial | open-verified | …), not a 3-value class.

publishable.description: Render gate: false = commercial/unverified lead, not served publicly until re-sourced.
